trial_title: The Effects of Annovera™ and Tampon Co-Usage on the Pharmacokinetics of Segesterone Acetate and Ethinyl Estradiol
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the effect of Annovera and tampon co-usage on the pharmacokinetics (PK) of segesterone acetate (SA) and ethinyl estradiol (EE).

eligibility_table.criterion: Healthy women, sterile or at risk of becoming pregnant, inclusive of ages 18 to 35 years at the enrollment visit.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 32 years old, which is within the inclusion age range of 18 to 35 years.

eligibility_table.criterion: Intact uterus and both ovaries.
eligibility_table.justification: Category not evaluable deterministically
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have an intact uterus and both ovaries confirmed by pelvic ultrasound?

eligibility_table.criterion: Prior history of regular menstrual cycles that usually occur every 28 ± 7 days when not using hormonal contraception; if postpartum or post-abortal, history of regular menstrual cycles of 21 to 35 days in length and resumption of at least one cycle with a cycle length consistent with her past cycles.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not had a menstrual period for 10 weeks, indicating irregular cycles, which does not meet the criterion for regular menstrual cycles.

eligibility_table.criterion: Willing to use oral contraception for one month prior to the initial insertion of Annovera.
